# API — Suzerain variable catalog

What each live/save variable key does. Keys are the in-game Lua variable
names (`BaseGame.*`, `RiziaDLC.*`, …); `Field` is the friendly name used
by `Suzerain-Save-Editor` and (planned) `BagOfTricks` presets.

> Source: `Suzerain-Save-Editor/Utils/Consts.py` (auto-generated — do not
> hand-edit tables; re-run `Utils/gen_api.py` after changing the source).
> Status: UNCONFIRMED against live game — save-editor maps are
> ~1yr old and mined saves are .153/.137-era while installed game is
> 3.1.0.1.175. Confirm each key live via `Agents/RESEARCH.md` before
> relying on it. Installed game: 3.1.0.1.175 (Steam build 23568265).
> Mechanism CONFIRMED against .175 dummy assemblies: `DialogueLua`.
> `GetVariable`/`SetVariable`, `LuaTable.Dict`, `LuaNumber.Number: double`.

Legend: `_field` (leading underscore) = internal/derived flag, not a
direct HUD stat. `—` in Key = composite UI field (see
`Models/Sordland.py` / `Models/Rizia.py` in save-editor), not a raw key.
Roles (from dialogue write/read sites + campaign variance): `store` = core
read-write state; `trigger` = one-shot event flag; `lever` = enactment flag;
`mirror` = engine-written, varies; `gate` = read-only branch input;
`record` = written, never branched on; `const` = static clamp/sentinel;
`dormant` = static, unreferenced (rare-branch or dead).

## Modify-together groups (save-editor semantics)

Keys that share one purpose and must be edited together. Kinds: `and` = setter writes all members to one value (getter is AND); `exclusive` = setter clears the group then sets one option; `inverse` = pair kept opposite; `compensating` = setting the total delta-adjusts the base — edit both.

| Group | Kind | Members / Options |
|---|---|---|
| `blackTuesday` | and | both keys always share one value; getter is AND: `BaseGame.BlackTuesdayHappened`, `BaseGame.Situation_Economy_MarketsCrash` |
| `superpowerTradeWar` | and | both keys always share one value; getter is AND: `BaseGame.SuperpowerTradeWarHappened`, `BaseGame.Situation_Economy_GlobalTradeWar` |
| `deanaLoved` | and | both keys always share one value; getter is AND: `BaseGame.Relations_Deana_Loved`, `BaseGame.Relations_Deana_Opinion` |
| `agnoliaTradeDeal` | and | both keys always share one value; getter is AND: `BaseGame.Agnolia_TradeDeal`, `BaseGame.Policy_Diplomacy_Agnolia_Trade` |
| `agnoliaAlliance` | and | both keys always share one value; getter is AND: `BaseGame.Agnolia_Alliance`, `BaseGame.Policy_Diplomacy_Agnolia_Alliance` |
| `wehlenTradeDeal` | and | both keys always share one value; getter is AND: `BaseGame.Wehlen_TradeDeal`, `BaseGame.Policy_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Trade` |
| `lespiaAlliance` | and | both keys always share one value; getter is AND: `BaseGame.Lespia_Alliance`, `BaseGame.Policy_Diplomacy_Lespia_Alliance` |
| `valgslandAlliance` | and | both keys always share one value; getter is AND: `BaseGame.Valgsland_Alliance`, `BaseGame.Policy_Diplomacy_Valgsland_Alliance` |
| `ATO` | and | both keys always share one value; getter is AND: `BaseGame.Policy_Diplomacy_ATO`, `BaseGame.Policy_Economy_ATOArea` |
| `CSP` | and | both keys always share one value; getter is AND: `BaseGame.Policy_Diplomacy_CSP`, `BaseGame.Policy_Economy_CSPArea` |
| `modernisedArmy` | and | both keys always share one value; getter is AND: `BaseGame.Situation_Military_ModernisedArmy`, `BaseGame.Turn06_SnO_Modernisation_Army` |
| `expandedArmy` | and | both keys always share one value; getter is AND: `BaseGame.Situation_Military_ExpandedArmy`, `BaseGame.Turn06_SnO_Expansion_Army` |
| `modernisedNavy` | and | both keys always share one value; getter is AND: `BaseGame.Situation_Military_ModernisedNavy`, `BaseGame.Turn06_SnO_Modernisation_Navy` |
| `expandedNavy` | and | both keys always share one value; getter is AND: `BaseGame.Situation_Military_ExpandedNavy`, `BaseGame.Turn06_SnO_Expansion_Navy` |
| `modernisedAirForce` | and | both keys always share one value; getter is AND: `BaseGame.Situation_Military_ModernisedAirForce`, `BaseGame.Turn06_SnO_Modernisation_Airforce` |
| `expandedAirForce` | and | both keys always share one value; getter is AND: `BaseGame.Situation_Military_ExpandedAirForce`, `BaseGame.Turn06_SnO_Expansion_Airforce` |
| `rumburgWarWin` | inverse | setting Win=true sets Lost=false and vice versa (inverse pair): `GameCondition.Turn11_SnO_RumburgWarWin`, `GameCondition.Turn11_SnO_RumburgWarLost` |
| `employment` | exclusive | setter clears the whole group, then sets one option: BAD=[BaseGame.Situation_Economy_UnemploymentCrisis]; GOOD=[BaseGame.Situation_Economy_HighEmployment] |
| `trade` | exclusive | setter clears the whole group, then sets one option: BAD=[BaseGame.Situation_Economy_DecreasedTrade]; GOOD=[BaseGame.Situation_Economy_IncreasedTrade] |
| `tax` | exclusive | setter clears the whole group, then sets one option: BAD=[BaseGame.Situation_Economy_TaxEvasion]; GOOD=[BaseGame.Situation_Economy_TaxEfficientEconomy]; MID=[BaseGame.Situation_Economy_TaxAvoidance] |
| `transportation` | exclusive | setter clears the whole group, then sets one option: BAD=[BaseGame.Situation_Economy_WeakTransportation]; GOOD=[BaseGame.Situation_Economy_ImprovedTransportation] |
| `tourism` | exclusive | setter clears the whole group, then sets one option: BAD=[BaseGame.Situation_Economy_Tourism_Declining]; GOOD=[BaseGame.Situation_Economy_Tourism_Booming]; MID=[BaseGame.Situation_Economy_Tourism_Average] |
| `situationAgnland` | exclusive | setter clears the whole group, then sets one option: BAD=[BaseGame.Situation_Economy_Agnland_LackInvestment]; GOOD=[BaseGame.Situation_Economy_Agnland_MajorFishExport]; MID=[BaseGame.Situation_Economy_Agnland_EconomicStabilisation] |
| `situationBergia` | exclusive | setter clears the whole group, then sets one option: BAD=[BaseGame.Situation_Economy_Bergia_EconomicDownturn]; GOOD=[BaseGame.Situation_Economy_Bergia_MajorAgriculturalZone]; MID=[BaseGame.Situation_Economy_Bergia_EconomicStabilisation] |
| `situationGruni` | exclusive | setter clears the whole group, then sets one option: BAD=[BaseGame.Situation_Economy_Gruni_LaggingBehind]; GOOD=[BaseGame.Situation_Economy_Gruni_LightTowerRegion]; MID=[BaseGame.Situation_Economy_Gruni_MaintainingGrowth] |
| `situationLorren` | exclusive | setter clears the whole group, then sets one option: BAD=[BaseGame.Situation_Economy_Lorren_RustBelt]; GOOD=[BaseGame.Situation_Economy_Lorren_ProductionAndTradeCenter]; MID=[BaseGame.Situation_Economy_Lorren_EconomicStabilisation] |
| `ewaldOpinion` | exclusive | setter clears the whole group, then sets one option (NONE clears all): DISCONTENT=[BaseGame.Relations_Ewald_Discontent]; FRIENDLY=[BaseGame.Relations_Ewald_Friendly]; NEUTRAL=[BaseGame.Relations_Ewald_Neutral]; NONE=[none] |
| `partyElectionResult` | exclusive | setter clears the whole group, then sets one option (NONE clears all): LOST=[BaseGame.Turn10_PartyCongress_Lost]; NEWPARTY=[BaseGame.Turn10_PartyCongress_FormNewParty]; NONE=[none]; WON=[BaseGame.Turn10_PartyCongress_Won] |
| `sordishRadioTVCouncilStatus` | exclusive | CONTROLLED sets council+controlled; INDEPENDENT sets council+independent; NONE clears all: CONTROLLED=[BaseGame.Reform_PresiPower_Weak_SordishRadioTVCouncil, BaseGame.Reform_PresiPower_Weak_SordishRadioTVCouncil_Controlled]; INDEPENDENT=[BaseGame.Reform_PresiPower_Weak_SordishRadioTVCouncil, BaseGame.Reform_PresiPower_Weak_SordishRadioTVCouncil_Independent]; NONE=[none] |
| `operationBearTrap` | exclusive | setter clears the whole group, then sets one option (NONE clears all): HIGH=[BaseGame.Wehlen_JointOperation]; MID=[BaseGame.Wehlen_DefendBorder]; NONE=[none] |
| `courtStatus` | exclusive | setter clears the whole group, then sets one option: BAD=[BaseGame.Situation_Law_CourtBacklog]; GOOD=[BaseGame.Situation_Law_EfficientJusticeSystem] |
| `womenRights` | exclusive | setter clears the whole group, then sets one option: BAD=[BaseGame.Situation_Law_LimitedWomenRights]; GOOD=[BaseGame.Situation_Law_ExcellentWomenRights]; MID=[BaseGame.Situation_Law_AverageWomenRights] |
| `corruption` | exclusive | setter clears the whole group, then sets one option: BAD=[BaseGame.Situation_Order_Corruption]; GOOD=[BaseGame.Situation_Order_CorruptionTackled] |
| `crime` | exclusive | setter clears the whole group, then sets one option: BAD=[BaseGame.Situation_Order_OrganisedCrime]; GOOD=[BaseGame.Situation_Order_OrganisedCrimeContained] |
| `vesordRumbergNavy` | exclusive | setter clears the whole group, then sets one option: BAD=[BaseGameSupport.Report_Turn10_Vesord_RumburgNavyInferior]; GOOD=[BaseGameSupport.Report_Turn10_Vesord_RumburgNavySuperior] |
| `authorityModifiersTotal` | compensating | setting the total delta-adjusts the base modifier (base += new-old); edit both or the total drifts: `RiziaDLC.Resources_AuthorityModifiersTotal`, `RiziaDLC.Authority_Modifier_BaseMonarchRomus` |
| `budgetModifiersTotal` | compensating | setting the total delta-adjusts the base modifier (base += new-old); edit both or the total drifts: `RiziaDLC.Resources_BudgetModifiersTotal`, `RiziaDLC.Budget_Modifier_RizianGoldIndustry` |
| `energyModifiersTotal` | compensating | setting the total delta-adjusts the base modifier (base += new-old); edit both or the total drifts: `RiziaDLC.Resources_EnergyModifiersTotal`, `RiziaDLC.Energy_Modifier_BaseEnergy` |
